gempauth-desc: Log in to the wiki with your GEMP (play.swccg.com) account
gempauth-unavailable: The GEMP login service is not responding right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
gempauth-banned: This GEMP account is banned, so it cannot log in to the wiki.
gempauth-temp-banned: This GEMP account is suspended until $1.
gempauth-rate-limited: Too many login attempts for this account. Please wait $1 and try again.
gempauth-reset-required: This GEMP account's password was reset. Set a new password on [$1 GEMP] first, then log in here.
gempauth-name-mismatch: Please type your GEMP name exactly as it is on GEMP.
gempauth-link-mismatch: This wiki name is already linked to a different GEMP account. Please ask a wiki administrator for help.
gempauth-password-on-gemp: This account logs in with GEMP. Change or reset its password on [$1 GEMP].
gempauth-confirm-email-to-edit: To edit this page you need a confirmed email address. Add one in [[Special:Preferences|your preferences]], then follow the link we email you ([[Special:ConfirmEmail|resend it]]). Talk pages are open without one.
right-editcontent: Edit content pages (articles, cards, templates, files) without the confirmed-email check
